claim: The 4c Naismith - Basketball plate proof for the Naismith - Basketball Issue is dated October 19, 1961.
notes: National Postal Museum record names only 'Naismith' with subject basketball; it gives no first name or dates, so the link to James Naismith (1861-1939) rests on the basketball subject. Leads: IHH page does not list a 1961 U.S. stamp (it lists a 1991 Canadian stamp).
